def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0]); frames=[]
    for color in range(1,10):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==color]
        if not pts: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)

            pat=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
            frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,pat))
    # Copy each nonempty interior motif only into empty frames with identical dimensions.
    # Demonstrations are reproduced by this operation.
    for src in frames:
        color0,r0s,r1s,c0s,c1s,pat=src

            for i,row in enumerate(pat):
                for j,v in enumerate(row):
                    if v: g[r0+1+i][c0+1+j]=color
    return g
